title: Settings
subtitle: Account, collection preferences, and session options.
languageHint: Changes the interface language. Card rules text is official in French and English; in other languages, it is translated by the site.
themeHint: Switch between dark mode (default) and light mode.
shareHint: Create a secret link: friends can view your collection read-only (no purchase prices or notes). They cannot edit anything.
shareRotated: New link generated. The old one no longer works.
collectionDefaultsHint: Applied when adding cards, sorting, and resetting filters (unless already set in the URL).
defaultCurrencyHint: Pre-selected when you save a purchase price.
defaultConditionHint: Used in quick-add mode and when adding from the card sheet.
defaultSortHint: Initial sort for the Cards grid.
defaultCollectionHint: Ownership filter applied on start and reset.
filtersPanelHint: Initial behavior of the side panel on Cards.
filtersPanelAuto: Auto (open on desktop, closed on mobile)
dataHint: Back up your collection, or import it from a spreadsheet or a Cardmarket export.
importHint: App CSV export, spreadsheet (name, number, set, language, condition, quantity, purchase price… columns) or Cardmarket export (stock or purchases).
importGuessed: {n} line(s) to check: several printings possible, the most common one was picked.
importCardmarketPrice: Cardmarket prices are selling prices: they are not imported as purchase prices.
importModeSet: Replace the quantity of cards in the file
importNoColumns: Columns not recognised: at least a name, a card number or an ID is required.
importNothing: No card recognised in this file.
